arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Ms. Spinelli argued the magistration marks the start of a criminal prosecution.
Mr. Coleman argued the magistration does not begin a criminal prosecution.
Justice Roberts questioned how the proceeding could be adversarial without the prosecution present.
Justice Kennedy sought a specific rule to tell states when counsel must be appointed.
